messages:
maya: quick flag — CI evals on the q4_0 build just flipped a bunch of metrics for the llama-compat suite. seeing quality drops ~5-8% on BLEU/sacrebleu. rolling release is blocked :exclamation:
ben: ugh. which run? full suite or a subset?
maya: full nightly evals. runner reported failures in the rerank and translation tests. attached log shows the stat diffs.
carla: can you paste the failing metric snippet?
maya: 
```
Metric: sacrebleu
baseline: 32.5
current(q4_0): 26.9
delta: -5.6
run_id: 2028-05-02_q4_0_canary
```

sam: note: the q4_0 kernel change landed in infra PR 7a8c9d8 yesterday (perf/kernel-selection). could be related to attention kernel fallback or fp16->int8 path.
ben: ran a quick local reproduce: `./tools/run_eval.sh --model llama-compat --quant q4_0 --suite translation --seed 42` — reproduced similar drop, so not just CI flakiness.
carla: do we have a bisect candidate? any single commit that correlates?
maya: eval-runner CI timeline shows metric flip right after 7a8c9d8 + a followup 9f3b2a1 which adjusted KV cache eviction heuristics. both touched runtime pathing.
eval-runner: automated bisect started: testing commits between 7a8c9d8..HEAD, estimated 10 jobs. will report earliest bad commit.
infra-bot: bisect job queued on dedicated runners (gpu-pool-3). ETA ~12m.
ben: if bisect points to kernel-selection commit, short-term rollback would be safer than landing a patch. that commit changed kernel heuristics for seq_len > 512.
maya: product asked to hold the rolling Dedicated release until this lands. we need a quick mitigation: can we create an allowlist to force float fallback for the translation suite?
sam: we can create a config toggle: `runtime.kernels.force_fallback = ["translation-suite"]` and flip in canary. low-risk.
carla: also want to verify quantization schedule: maybe the q4 mapping change interacts with cache eviction. run an eval with `--kv-eviction=disabled` as a control.
ben: logs show increased token-level perplexity when combined with eviction. disabling eviction largely recovers BLEU in a small run.
eval-runner: bisect finished: first bad commit identified: 7a8c9d8 (perf/kernel-selection). reproducer confirms regression.
maya: ok — plan: 1) revert 7a8c9d8 in release branch (hotfix) 2) land runtime.kernels.force_fallback toggle to reduce blast radius 3) run full nightly before unblocking release.
sam: I'll open the hotfix PR now and include the canary toggle. pinging @carla for quick review on recovery plan.
carla: on it, will review in 15. also let's add a small eval matrix to CI that runs q4_0 translation with eviction disabled/enabled as a regression gate.
ben: agree. add a metric threshold rule: sacrebleu delta must be > -1.0 vs pinned baseline or fail CI.
maya: thanks all. adding note to release thread and blocking the rollout until hotfix validated :thumbsup:
infra-bot: hotfix PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/478 (revert 7a8c9d8). CI: queued.
carla: looks good. once CI and the canary pass, we can un-block. :eyes:
maya: closing loop — will post final verification logs here after nightly.
